description: Modal 'Create Class' dialog (SAPLFVW4115_1), opened by fwzz-entry's Create button. Asks Product Type / Short Name / Long Name plus two radio groups (Active|Inactive, With Reference|Without Reference - both left at their defaults, Active / Without Reference, since neither control type exists in this suite's screen-model vocabulary and the defaults are what this case wants). Create (F5) opens the class master (fwzz-class-master.json) - it does not commit by itself.

idNumber.title: Security Class ID Number
idNumber.note: nth=0 is the read-only mirror carried over from the entry screen; nth=1 is this dialog's own editable copy. Left blank for 26B - see fwzz-entry.json's idNumber note.

shortName.title: Short Name
shortName.note: max 15 chars - SAP truncates silently, does not refuse.

createConfirmButton.note: 'Create (F5)'. Opens the class master. Does not commit - Save on the master screen is the actual write.

continueButton.note: Dismisses an informational popup that can appear here (e.g. the internal-numbering notice if an id was typed for 26B). Purely navigational.
